caption: The drawing depicts three primary objects arranged horizontally on a plain background: a vertical white candle, a small round metallic or tin dish, and a tool with a long metallic shaft and a rounded, dark wooden handle. The white candle, positioned upright, has irregular melting and dripping marks on its sides and is partially used, with a short wick at the top. The candle is placed in the center of a shallow circular dish or holder, which is shaded in gray and features subtle lines indicating its depth. The tool, whose metallic shaft runs through the dish beneath the candle, extends outward on both sides of the dish. Its right end is capped with a dark, rounded wooden handle, which tapers slightly before flaring at the end. The composition is simple, with the objects centrally placed within a lightly sketched rectangular border. The colors used are neutral, mainly whites, grays, and browns. The dish and candle take up the left side of the image, while the handle occupies the right. The overall drawing has a naturalistic and softly shaded appearance, with no background details, focusing entirely on the depicted objects.
title: Candlestick
